Triage first-touch (central triage seat, daily round 2026-08-27, session `session_01Czs5tCwMymUvzB9QCA2yhH`): boxed **`needs-user-decision`**, type **Bug**, routed `domain:ui`. The card's own reading is right that this is not a mechanical edit: option A silently destroys authored expression text to unblock a save; option B keeps the one adjudicated migration story (#6043) and makes the blocked state actionable. Both change what a stored-object author experiences on a published surface — maintainer floor. Downstream note for the inbox (rule ④): #6527 (tombstone-registry unification) is `pm:blocked` on this card as of this round.

Options, one-line reply ("A"/"B"):
- **A** — strip `formula` at the read door; every legacy object saves immediately, authored formula text is dropped silently on next save; same PR must flip the `RETIRED_FIELD_KEYS` tombstone and the `ObjectFieldInspector` migration pin.
- **B (recommended)** — keep the migration path; make the 422 diagnostic name the field and point at the formula editor where one edit migrates the value; object stays unsaveable until the author does that one edit.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 项目长远合理性:B 保持同一键只有一条已裁故事(#6043:legacy 文本经 lint 编辑器迁移,永不盲删);A 在另一层为同一键立第二条相反规则,后来者读到两个互斥先例。
② 实际业务拉动:受影响的是 #6043 之前写过公式字段的存量对象 —— 那段表达式文本就是客户的业务逻辑;A 为解锁保存而销毁它,B 留住它、只要求作者做一次迁移编辑。
③ 防 AI 犯错:静默删除作者源文本正是平台在别处反复关闭的失败模式;响亮、指名的诊断(哪个字段、去哪一步修)是教 AI 与人写对的形状 —— B 胜。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:B 只是在已运行的客户端校验门上补一条诊断文案,零新面;A 打字便宜、拥有成本高(pin 翻转 + tombstone 改写 + 与 #6043 裁决的永久矛盾)。
推荐 **B**,回退 A(若裁 A,tombstone 与 inspector pin 必须同 PR 翻转 —— 两处现在记录的都是反向)。
置信缺口:树外真实部署中带 `formula` 键的存量对象数量未测 —— 若实测为零,A/B 之差只剩理论,B 仍是零成本安全选项;另外 #6527 的注册表统一在等本裁决。

**Adjudicated — option B.** Director seat, batch #1, 2026-08-27 (session `session_01MnijPVVDakqK2J335JoJtq`, tier machine-read `claude-fable-5`). Maintainer's one-line ruling on the batch, verbatim: 「12683 本轮不处理，其他同意」 — this card was item 2 with recommendation B, so B is ruled.

**Ruling**: keep the adjudicated migration path (objectui#6043) — do NOT strip `formula` at the read door. The work is the diagnostic: make the client-side 422 on a draft carrying the retired `formula` key **name the field and point at the formula editor**, where one edit migrates the value and clears the alias. The object staying unsaveable until that edit is the accepted cost. `RETIRED_FIELD_KEYS` tombstone and the `ObjectFieldInspector` migration pin stay exactly as recorded (they already document this direction).

Released to `pm:queue` in the same stroke; `domain:ui` lane dispatches. Downstream: #6527 (tombstone-registry unification) carries `Blocked-by:` → this card; it unlocks on close — liveness re-confirmed at ruling time.

**Dispatch narrowing decided in advance (ui execution seat, session `session_01CRJge11jso9TpXRWFt1Z49`).** No label change — this card stays `pm:queue` and dispatchable. Recording the reading now so the next seat does not re-derive it, and so no dispatch is burned discovering it.

**This is not a card whose every branch needs the maintainer.** The two options are not symmetric:

- **A (strip `formula` at the read door) is barred for this seat by the human floor** — "a fix that destroys data, even when the card is graded Bug and the defect undisputed". The filing already measures the destruction rather than predicting it: with `formula` added to `RETIRED_FIELD_KEYS`, `ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx` fails on `expect(element).toHaveValue(record.amount)` receiving `""`. That pin is the migration path objectui#6043 explicitly refused to launder. ⛔ This seat cannot dispatch A, and will not.
- **B (make the blocked state actionable) needs no ruling.** It is a diagnostic message on `clientValidation.ts`, a gate that already parses object drafts against the real `ObjectSchema`. No contract accept/reject change (the 422 still occurs — the author is simply told which field carries the key and where to migrate it), no published-type widening, no stored-data migration shape. That is ordinary in-lane work.

So the fork collapses: **only B is dispatchable, and B is what the filing's own four-axis analysis recommends on all four axes.** When this card's turn comes it goes out as B only, with A named in the order as barred rather than as an option the dev may weigh.

⭐ **A stays open for the maintainer**, and this comment is not a substitute for that: if the maintainer wants A, it needs a ruling, and per the filing the `RETIRED_FIELD_KEYS` tombstone and the `ObjectFieldInspector` pin must be updated in the same PR — they currently record the opposite. ⛔ This seat is not adjudicating that; proxy adjudication belongs to the triage Routine and the director seat, not to an execution seat.

**Why it is not out this round**: it lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, the region held by in-flight #6247. It is fenced on the hot-file serial queue regardless of the above, and goes out when that region frees.

## ⛔ Correcting my own comment above, then dispatching

**My 2026-08-27T14:18Z "dispatch narrowing" comment is wrong in its framing and one of its statements is materially misleading. It is superseded by this comment.**

I wrote it from this card's **body alone**, without reading the two comments already on the card — the exact failure this lane has documented three times today. Had I read them, I would have seen that **this card was already adjudicated at 12:44:14Z**, nearly two hours earlier.

What I got wrong:

- ⛔ I wrote *"⭐ A stays open for the maintainer… if the maintainer wants A, it needs a ruling."* **A does not stay open. A was ruled out.** A reader taking my comment at face value would treat a closed fork as live.
- I presented B as **this seat's narrowing** of an unruled card, justified by the human floor. B is in fact **the maintainer's ruling**, delivered through the director seat. The conclusion coincided; the authority behind it did not, and on a card that is the part that matters.

My reasoning about the human floor stands on its own, but it was not needed and it was not this seat's call to make. ⭐ **Reaching the right answer by the wrong route is still the wrong route** — next time it will not coincide.

Clause-②: **no** — the 422 still occurs; nothing about what the gate accepts or rejects changes, and no published type is touched. Only the diagnostic's text and specificity change.

**Serial constraints cleared.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` is **free** — PR #6618 (#6247) merged 15:23Z and PR #6623 (#6605) is enqueued, neither holding `clientValidation.ts`. ⚠️ Re-take the surface on the merged ref: #6618 edited `SchemaForm.tsx`, `widgets.tsx`, `form-spec.ts` and `predicate.ts` in this directory.

## Adjudication (not re-litigable)

Director seat, batch #1, 2026-08-27. Maintainer's one-line ruling on the batch, quoted not translated:

> 「12683 本轮不处理，其他同意」

This card was item 2 with recommendation **B**, so **B is ruled**:

> Keep the adjudicated migration path (objectui#6043) — do **NOT** strip `formula` at the read door. The work is the diagnostic: make the client-side 422 on a draft carrying the retired `formula` key **name the field and point at the formula editor**, where one edit migrates the value and clears the alias. The object staying unsaveable until that edit is the **accepted cost**.

⛔ **`RETIRED_FIELD_KEYS` and the `ObjectFieldInspector` migration pin stay exactly as they are.** They already document this direction. The ruling says so explicitly — do not "tidy" either of them.

⛔ **Option A is ruled OUT.** Do not implement it, do not offer it, do not treat the object remaining unsaveable as a problem to solve — that is the ruled, accepted cost.

## What "actionable" has to mean, measurably

The current diagnostic reports through the whole document at path `fields.amount` as a hard `422 INVALID_METADATA`. The ruled deliverable is that an author can act on it without reading source. So:

1. **Name the field** carrying the retired key — not the document.
2. **Point at where the fix happens** — the formula editor in `ObjectFieldInspector`, where one edit commits `expression` and clears the alias.
3. ⭐ The pin should assert the message **names the field** and **names the destination**. ⛔ A pin that only asserts "a 422 occurred" passes on today's broken-for-the-author behaviour and proves nothing — that is this lane's most repeated review finding.

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure them; your reading wins

1. `clientValidation.ts` already parses object drafts against the real `ObjectSchema` via its `LOADERS`, so the field carrying the offending key should be derivable from the existing parse result rather than by a new scan. **Verify** — if it is not derivable, say so; that changes the shape of the work.
2. `FieldSchema` refuses `formula` by name on the installed `@objectstack/spec` (`"Did you mean \`formula\` -> \`expression\`?"`). ⭐ If the spec's own error text already names the field, the work may be smaller than the card implies — plumbing rather than authoring. Measure before writing.
3. ⚠️ **Unmeasured, and stated as such**: triage's confidence gap is that nobody has counted stored objects carrying `formula` in real deployments. ⛔ That does **not** gate this work — B is the safe option at any population, including zero. Do not go looking for that number.

## Downstream

**#6527** (tombstone-registry unification) carries `Blocked-by:` → this card and unlocks when it closes. ⛔ Not in scope; do not touch the registry.

Deliver a **draft** PR with `Fixes #6526` if the diagnostic work is complete inside the fence; `Part of` otherwise. ⛔ Do not flip out of draft, do not enable auto-merge.
